theater: 福克蘭群島與南喬治亞島

battle.name: 福克蘭戰爭
battle.theater: 福克蘭群島與南喬治亞島
battle.brief: 一九八二年四月二日阿根廷登陸福克蘭群島，英國派海軍遠征艦隊，傘兵與突擊兵在群島西岸登陸，七十四天後奪回斯坦利。卡面這門一八五〇年的德國線膛野戰砲早已退役，但它寫下的射程邏輯仍留在島上：英軍一〇五毫米野戰榴彈砲與阿根廷一〇五毫米榴彈砲隔山對射，守住市區的每一道門。

kit.name: 線膛砲
kit.history: 線膛讓同樣的藥量走得更遠。砲兵第一次可以在射程上贏步兵。

countries: 交戰方是阿根廷與英國兩個國家，爭執的地面是福克蘭群島與南喬治亞島。阿根廷方面由軍政府直接指揮：總統兼陸軍總司令雷奧波爾多·加爾特耶里主持一切，海軍由參謀長豪爾赫·伊薩克·阿納亞統率，空軍由安赫爾·路易斯·扎納塔中將指揮。入侵部隊編為「三角地」特遣集群，陸軍第三軍團由盧西亞諾·班哈明·梅嫩德斯少將率領，含第一、第二、第三步兵旅；海軍陸戰隊第四團由卡洛斯·豪爾赫·拉科斯特少將率領，負責灘頭與垂直登陸。海軍投入巡洋艦「赫爾曼·貝格爾諾」號、兩艘改裝巡洋艦與多艘驅逐艦，航空兵配備「幻影三號」戰鬥機、「天鷹」式攻擊機、裝甲螺旋槳攻擊機「普卡拉」與法製「超級山」攻擊機；南喬治亞由普雷維登西亞海軍基地守軍與遊擊隊把守。英國方面由柴契爾內閣拍板，國防大臣約翰·諾特與參謀長特倫斯·魯因策劃，總督雷克斯·亨特留守群島；海軍旗艦指揮官初為克里斯多福·福爾德，四月底由約翰·伍德華德接任。陸軍由傑里米·布萊克少將指揮，第三突擊旅、傘兵第二團、第一／第七廓爾喀步兵連與禁衛隊營組成地面部隊，海軍陸戰隊突擊隊、皇家海軍艦隊、皇家空軍「海鷗」式攻擊機與陸軍航空隊「海王」直升機共同參戰。
countriesEn: The two belligerents were Argentina and the United Kingdom, and the ground at issue was the Falkland Islands and South Georgia. On the Argentine side command rested with the military junta: President and Army commander-in-chief Leopoldo Galtieri presided over everything, the Navy was run by Chief of the Joint Staff Jorge Isaac Anaya, and the Air Force by Air Vice-Marshal Héctor Luis Zannatta. The invasion force was organised as a task force for 「Operation Rosario」. The Army's III Army Corps was led by Major General Luciano Benjamín Menéndez and comprised the 1st, 2nd and 3rd Infantry Brigades, while the 4th Marine Infantry Regiment under Rear Admiral Carlos Jorge Lacoste was responsible for the beach landings and for vertical insertion. At sea Argentina committed the cruiser General Belgrano, two converted cruisers and a number of destroyers, while its air arm fielded Mirage III fighters, IA-58 Pucará and A-4P Skyhawk attack aircraft and French-built Super Étendard strike aircraft; South Georgia was held by the garrison of the naval base at Puerto Belgrano together with irregular guerrillas. On the British side the decision was taken by Thatcher's cabinet, with Defence Secretary John Nott and Chief of the Defence Staff Admiral Terence Lewin planning the operation and Governor Sir Rex Hunt remaining on the islands. The naval flag officer was at first Rear Admiral Christopher Ford and from late April Rear Admiral John Woodward. On land Major General Jeremy Blacker commanded a force built around 3 Commando Brigade, 2 Para, 1/7 Gurkha Rifles and the Guards, supported by the Royal Marines' commando units, the Royal Navy, the RAF's Sea Harriers and the Army Air Corps' Sea Kings.
people: 關鍵人物集中在兩端。英方是柴契爾夫人，她的內閣在四月二日得到阿根廷入侵的消息後當日批准派遣英國海軍特遣艦隊；主張出兵的是國防大臣諾特與參謀長魯因，魯因的計劃是先用海軍封鎖，再以傘兵與突擊兵在敵後灘頭建立據點，最後由海軍陸戰隊攻佔斯坦利。旗艦指揮官約翰·伍德華德上任後改採「射後即走」的防空與反潛部署，雖然護航的「謝菲爾德」號與「科文翠」號相繼被反艦飛彈擊沉，他仍靠英國本土與亞森森島的補給、還有友方運力維持遠距作戰，最終等到突擊旅攻入斯坦利。英方指揮官還包括第三突擊旅旅長西蒙·法拉爾少將、傘兵第二團團長休·派克中校、在古斯格林陣亡並追頒維多利亞十字勳章的赫比·瓊斯上尉，以及禁衛隊與廓爾喀營的各級指揮官。阿根廷方面，總統兼陸軍總司令加爾特耶里簽署了入侵命令，海軍總司令阿納亞主張先取南喬治亞再攻群島，陸軍參謀長反對全面升級卻被免職；群島總督司令是海軍少將埃克托·龐索，陸軍上校布倫特·福賽斯主持福克蘭市區的防務，最後在斯坦利簽下投降書。
peopleEn: The decisive figures sit at the two ends of the conflict. On the British side there was Margaret Thatcher, whose cabinet authorised the sailing of the task force on the very day it learned of the Argentine landings, on 2 April. The men who argued for intervention were Defence Secretary John Nott and Chief of the Defence Staff Terence Lewin, and Lewin's plan was to seal the islands by sea first, to establish beachheads in the enemy's rear with paras and commandos, and finally to take Stanley with the Royal Marines. Rear Admiral John Woodward, who took over the flag, switched to a shoot-and-scoot doctrine for air defence and anti-submarine work: although the escorting Sheffield and Coventry were sunk in turn by anti-ship missiles, he still sustained the distant operation from the United Kingdom and Ascension Island together with allied lift, and in the end the commando brigade broke into Stanley. Other British commanders included Brigadier Simon Farrar, commanding 3 Commando Brigade, Lieutenant-Colonel Hew Pike of 2 Para, and Captain Hew Jones of 2 Para, who was killed at Goose Green and was posthumously awarded the Victoria Cross, together with the commanders of the Guards and Gurkha companies. On the Argentine side President and Army commander-in-chief Galtieri signed the order to invade; Admiral Anaya favoured taking South Georgia first and the islands afterwards, while the Army's chief of staff opposed an all-out escalation and was dismissed for it. The island commander was Rear Admiral Héctor Bonzo, with Colonel Brent D. Forsyth running the defence of the Stanley area; the two of them signed the surrender.
kits: 卡面這門一八五〇年的德國線膛野戰砲，代表的是「火藥推力換射程」的思路：膛線讓同樣的藥量走得更遠，砲兵第一次可以在射程上贏步兵。到一九八二年這門砲早已退出野戰，但它的一脈後代仍站在福克蘭的陣地上：英軍的核心火砲是英造「L119」一〇五毫米五吋架退式野戰榴彈砲，配可折疊砲架、分裝藥包與延期引信，最大射程約二十四公里，交戰中以四發急促射為主，由前線觀察所呼叫射表；海軍陸戰隊第三突擊旅的砲兵連與禁衛隊的砲兵連都裝了這種砲。同源血緣的外國版本是阿根廷軍隊的一〇五毫米榴彈砲與一五五毫米野戰砲，多屬阿根廷兵工廠自製或引進型，與英軍同屬一〇五毫米系列，可以互相估算射表。群島兩端的固定砲位更古老：達爾文與威爾萊茲山各有數門英制五又二分之一吋海軍岸防砲，射程約一萬三千米，構成福克蘭市區的骨幹火力。輕武器方面，英軍步兵用英造L1A1與L1A3自勤步槍、白朗寧通用機槍、八一迫擊砲與米蘭反裝甲火箭筒；阿根廷步兵配FN FAL七點六二毫米步槍、MAG五八機槍、七六式反裝甲火箭筒、二〇與四〇毫米高射砲，另以「地空」一型防空飛彈營攜帶飛魚反艦飛彈，構成對英國海空最大的威脅。除步砲之外，英軍靠護衛艦與巡洋艦的一〇五與一二七毫米艦砲做間歇支援，兩軍的補給則靠約八十艘商船與數艘登陸艦在五千五百公里外往返，單程航程就要兩到三星期。
kitsEn: The muzzle-loading field gun of 1850 on the card face stands for a single idea: trading the energy of the powder charge for reach. Rifling let the same charge travel further, and artillery could for the first time outrange the infantry. By 1982 that gun had long left the field, but one of its descendants still stood on the Falklands: the core of British artillery was the British-built L119 105 mm (5-inch) towed field howitzer, with a folding bipod, separate-loading charges and delay fuzes, capable of about 24 kilometres, fired in four-round rapid salvos under the call of forward observers. The Royal Marine artillery troop of 3 Commando Brigade and the Guards' artillery batteries all carried the type. The foreign version of the same bloodline was the Argentine Army's 105 mm howitzers and 155 mm field guns, largely built under licence at the Argentine arsenal, again in the 105 mm series, so that the two sides could each estimate the other's range tables. The fixed batteries at the ends of the islands were older still: Darwin and Wireless Ridge each mounted several British 5.5-inch naval coast defence guns with a range of roughly 13,000 metres, and these formed the backbone of the firepower over the town of Stanley. Among the light weapons the British infantry carried L1A1 and L1A3 self-loading rifles, Browning general-purpose machine guns, 81 mm mortars and Milan anti-tank launchers; the Argentine infantry were equipped with 7.62 mm FN FAL rifles, MAG 58 machine guns, 76 mm anti-tank rocket launchers, 20 mm and 40 mm anti-aircraft guns, and S-300 (H) surface-to-air missile batteries carrying Exocet anti-ship missiles, which posed the gravest threat to the British fleet and air force. Beyond the field guns, the British relied on the 105 mm and 127 mm guns of frigates and cruisers for occasional support, and both sides depended on some eighty merchant ships and several landing ships shuttling five and a half thousand kilometres from Britain, two to three weeks of steaming for each leg of the round trip.
tactics: 英軍的戰術圍繞「海空封鎖加灘頭縱深」展開。遠征艦隊自四月初離開本土，穿越南大西洋，四月十一日在聖卡洛斯灣與菲茨羅伊同時登陸：傘兵第二團由「加拉海德」號送上陸，禁衛隊營由「特里斯譚准將」號上岸，同一時間皇家海軍「赫卡特」號巡洋艦以四又二分之一吋砲壓制岸上守軍，一次支援射擊發射四百六十五發，替登陸隊清出灘頭。英國的攻勢重點不在立即奪取福克蘭市區，而是沿海岸公路由西向東推進——經蒂爾因特、肯特山、哈麗雅山與「二姊妹峰」直指斯坦利，全程約一百三十公里；公路兩側是沼澤、峽谷與連續山脊，車隊只能縱隊行進，每推進一兩公里就得停車整理。空軍方面，「海鷗」式攻擊機自「無畏」與「光輝」兩艘航空母艦起飛晝間攻擊，護航兵艦上的「海標」式戰鬥機則採「射後即走」，發射後立即離開防空區。地面進攻中，四月二十八至二十九日的古斯格林是樣板：傘兵第二團沿「二姊妹峰」山脊正面推進，第一／第七廓爾喀步兵連從「狹窄頸」側翼迂迴，用爆炸筒炸開鐵絲網，最終奪下聚落，傘兵團長與一名上尉在裡面陣亡。代價在六月集中爆發：朗敦山是斯坦利北面唯一的高地，蘇格蘭禁衛隊第二營正面強攻失利傷亡過半；威爾萊茲山由威爾士禁衛隊第二營攻下，兩役合計英軍傷亡數百人。防守的阿根廷軍在火炮運用上相當到家：固定砲位與一〇五毫米榴彈砲配合作戰觀察所施放反砲兵火力，把英軍砲位逐個壓制，又以民兵與後備兵力填補要點；但英軍最終以「子午線」為界的封鎖線與連續砲火把守軍從福克蘭市區逼入山區，於六月十四日簽降。
tacticsEn: British doctrine was built on sea and air blockade plus a beachhead in the enemy's rear. The task force sailed in early April and crossed the South Atlantic; on 11 April it landed simultaneously at San Carlos Water and Fitzroy. 2 Para went ashore from Sir Galahad, the Guards battalion from Sir Tristram, and at the same moment the cruiser HMS Hecate put four-and-a-half-inch shells onto the shore defences, firing 465 rounds in a single supporting shoot and clearing the beach for the landings. The British effort was not directed at seizing Stanley at once but at pushing east along the coastal road — through Teal Inte, Mount Kent, Mount Harriet and the Two Sisters — a run of about 130 kilometres. On both sides of that road lay marsh, ravine and continuous ridgeline, so the vehicles had to move in column and every kilometre or two the column had to stop and re-form. In the air, Sea Harriers flew from the carriers Invincible and Hermes to strike by day, while the Sea Dart fighters of the escorting ships used a shoot-and-scoot tactic, breaking away the instant they had fired. On the ground, Goose Green on 28 and 29 May was the pattern: 2 Para advanced along the ridge of the Two Sisters while 1/7 Gurkha Rifles outflanked them through Narrow Neck, blowing the wire with bangalore charges, and the settlement was finally taken, the battalion commander and a captain being killed in the process. The bill came due in June: Mount Longdon, the only high ground north of Stanley, was assaulted frontally by the 2nd Battalion Scots Guards and the attack failed with heavy loss, while Wireless Ridge was taken by the 2nd Battalion Welsh Guards; between them the two frontal attacks cost the British hundreds of casualties. Argentine gunnery was quietly skilful: the fixed batteries and the 105 mm howitzers worked with forward observers to shoot counter-battery, knocking out British gun positions one by one, and militia and reserves were fed into the key points. In the end a British cordon and a steady volume of fire pushed the garrison out of Stanley into the hills, and on 14 June it signed the surrender.
data: 可以引用的數字大致如下。戰爭自一九八二年四月二日阿根廷登陸到六月十四日斯坦利投降，前後七十四天，約十週又四天。入侵方投入的地面部隊約一萬人，另有海軍約五千人、飛機四十二架、運輸船十二艘，實際控制群島的守軍在三千至五千人之間；英方遠征兵力約四千人，另有海軍三千五百人，護航與支援艦艇八十餘艘，絕大多數兵力自本土直航，航程五千五百公里。傷亡方面，阿根廷官方公布陣亡六百四十九人、受傷約一千六百五十人，被俘約一萬一千三百人，其後分批遣返九千餘人；英方軍人陣亡一百二十三人，受傷約七百七十五人，另有商船與油輪船員殉職。損失清單同樣清楚：阿根廷失去巡洋艦一艘、驅逐艦兩艘、潛艦一艘與商船兩艘；英方損失水面主力艦四艘，即「謝菲爾德」號、「科文翠」號、「安特洛普」號與「阿登特」號，另有登陸後勤艦與貨櫃船「大西洋輸送者」號沉沒，一艘輔助巡邏船亦遭擊沉。距離上，聖卡洛斯到斯坦利約一百三十公里，古斯格林在福克蘭市區以西約一百公里，朗敦山在斯坦利西北約十二公里，南喬治亞的格里維肯距斯坦利約一千三百公里。時間上最關鍵的一筆是「大西洋輸送者」號：它沉沒時隨船沉入海底的四十枚「海標」攔截飛彈與數套「海貓」發射系統，令英國護航群五月下旬可用攔截彈大幅減少，成為六月地面戰的關鍵變數。
dataEn: The figures that can safely be quoted run like this. The war ran from the Argentine landings on 2 April 1982 to the surrender at Stanley on 14 June, seventy-four days in all, or ten weeks and four days. Argentina put about 10,000 men on the ground, together with roughly 5,000 naval personnel, forty-two aircraft and twelve transport vessels, while the garrison actually holding the islands numbered between three and five thousand. Britain sent about 4,000 men ashore and had some 3,500 more at sea, with eighty-odd warships and support vessels; the bulk of the force sailed straight from Britain, a passage of five and a half thousand kilometres. In casualties Argentina officially published 649 dead and about 1,650 wounded, with some 11,300 prisoners taken, more than nine thousand of whom were repatriated in batches; the British lost 123 service personnel dead and about 775 wounded, with merchant and tanker crews also killed. The loss lists are just as clear: Argentina lost a cruiser, two destroyers, a submarine and two merchant ships; Britain lost four major surface warships, the Sheffield, Coventry, Antelope and Ardent, together with a landing logistics ship and the container ship Atlantic Conveyor, and a support patrol vessel was also sunk. As for distances, San Carlos lies about 130 kilometres from Stanley, Goose Green roughly 100 kilometres west of the town, Mount Longdon some 12 kilometres north-west of Stanley, and Grytviken on South Georgia about 1,300 kilometres from Stanley. The most consequential figure in the calendar is that of Atlantic Conveyor: when she went down, forty Sea Dart interceptor missiles and several Sea Cat launchers went with her to the bottom, and the reduction in usable interceptors available to the British escort group in the last third of May was the key variable in the land battle of June.
cause: 直接起因是阿根廷軍政府選擇在戰前最後窗口動手。二戰後阿根廷長期主張對馬爾維納斯群島（英國稱福克蘭群島）擁有主權；一九八二年三月的火地島海峽主權爭端中，阿根廷海軍在比格爾島附近登上了英方有意讓出的海峽島礁，兩國艦隊在海峽裡槍口相向，這件事在國內被視為屈辱，成了軍政府轉移壓力的藉口。加爾特耶里本已面臨一九八二年六月的國會改選與惡劣的經濟形勢，軍方擔心選舉失敗，也擔心軍隊內部不穩，於是把一場以「收還馬爾維納斯」為名的軍事行動設計成數星期內可完成的速戰速決，希望藉此凝聚民族認同、鞏固軍政府。英國方面的導火線則是四月二日阿根廷對福克蘭群島的實際入侵本身，加上外交上長期低估阿根廷的決心，以及遠征決定拖延了數日。
causeEn: The immediate cause was the Argentine junta choosing the last window before the polls. After the Second World War Argentina had long claimed sovereignty over the Islas Malvinas, which Britain calls the Falkland Islands; in March 1982, amid the Beagle Channel dispute over the straits off Tierra del Fuego, Argentine sailors landed on islets in the strait which Britain had deliberately left unoccupied, and the two navies stood off one another with guns trained. Domestically this was treated as a humiliation and became the junta's excuse for diverting pressure. Galtieri was already facing a legislative election in June 1982 and a bad economic situation; the army feared losing the vote and feared disaffection in the ranks, so an operation in the name of recovering the Malvinas was designed to be over in a matter of weeks, in the hope of forging national unity and legitimising military rule. On the British side the trigger was the actual Argentine landing on the Falklands on 2 April, compounded by a long diplomatic underestimation of Argentine resolve and a delay of several days in taking the decision to sail the task force.
impact: 這場戰爭同時改變了兩個國家的政治版圖與一個國家的軍事政策。阿根廷軍政府戰敗後立刻失去執政合法性：加爾特耶里於六月十八日下台，海軍掌權，阿根廷年底恢復憲政，翌年總統大選由雷吉·阿方辛領導的激進公民聯盟勝出，長期執政的軍人政治終結；福克蘭的失敗也讓馬爾維納斯成為阿根廷民族主義的凝聚符號，一九八六年國會通過「全面終止法」，一九八九年的特赦法則在大批涉案軍人之間引發爭議。國際法層面上，本案成為「持續爭議領土」與民族自決原則的典型案例，一九八五年聯合國大會決議要求英阿重啟談判，此後每年的聯合國大會都有相近決議，英阿關係長期受此牽動。英國方面，柴契爾在六月一九八二年大選中以壓倒性優勢連任，勝利把「福爾克蘭斯因素」寫進一九八三年大選的記憶裡；國防政策的後果更為實際——海軍發現以「海標」飛彈護衛的艦隊面對反艦飛彈時防空不足，載著攔截彈的「大西洋輸送者」號沉沒暴露補給船同樣脆弱，於是英國海軍在往後十年重新檢討反艦與防空編制，把重點放在能攔截反艦飛彈的新型驅逐艦上。戰役細節也長期影響英軍訓練：後勤艦的脆弱性、艦隊在遙遠海域的加油與維修、以及沒有空軍大本營時如何維持制空權，都成了此後二十年英國國防爭論的固定題目。
impactEn: The war altered the political map of two countries and the military policy of a third. The Argentine junta lost its legitimacy the moment it was defeated: Galtieri was removed on 18 June, the Navy took power, constitutional government was restored before the end of the year, and at the following year's presidential election the Radical Civic Union led by Raúl Alfonsín won, ending the long military rule in Argentina. The defeat also turned the Malvinas into a rallying symbol of Argentine nationalism, with Congress passing the Full Stop Law in 1986 and the 1989 amnesty provoking fierce argument among the officers involved. In international law the case became a textbook example of territory under dispute and of the principle of self-determination: a General Assembly resolution in 1985 called for Britain and Argentina to resume negotiations, and similar resolutions have been voted every year since, keeping the bilateral relationship under constant strain. For Britain the political consequences were immediate — Thatcher's crushing re-election in June 1982 made the Falklands factor part of the memory of the 1983 general election — but the military consequences were more practical. The navy had learned that a fleet screened with Sea Dart was thinly defended against anti-ship missiles, and the loss of Atlantic Conveyor showed that the supply ships were just as vulnerable; over the following decade the Royal Navy re-examined its anti-surface and air defence arrangements and concentrated on new destroyers able to intercept anti-ship missiles. The campaign also shaped British training for years: the vulnerability of logistics ships, the problem of fuelling and repairing a fleet in far waters, and how to hold air control without a forward airfield all became standing subjects in British defence argument.
result: 結果是英國的完全勝利與阿根廷軍政府的垮台。六月的十天裡，第三突擊旅沿海岸公路逐段推進：六月十一至十二日，蘇格蘭禁衛隊第二營攻「朗敦山」失利，威爾士禁衛隊第二營攻下「威爾萊茲山」，代價是英軍在兩次正面攻擊中傷亡數百人，朗敦山一役蘇格蘭禁衛隊第二營幾乎被打空。六月十三日威爾士禁衛隊在「特姆布爾敦山」正面突破阿根廷守軍的阻擊，同時海軍與空軍對福克蘭市區的攻擊令守軍明白抵抗只會帶來更大傷亡。阿根廷群島守軍最終在六月十四日由海軍少將埃克托·龐索與陸軍上校布倫特·福賽斯代表，向英軍投降並在投降書上簽字，約一萬一千名俘虜被移交，武器、裝備與文件一併繳獲，英軍隨後在群島各地肅清殘餘抵抗。戰後兩年裡，英國維持群島的軍事存在，海軍陸戰隊與工程兵修建跑道、港口與兵營，一九八四年英國把群島與南喬治亞的防務撥給新設立的「福克蘭群島領土」最高指揮部。阿根廷從未放棄馬爾維納斯主權聲索，此後英阿關係在聯合國與南大西洋反覆出現摩擦，二〇一二年群島當局另設「馬爾維納斯日」，近年的外交緊張中阿根廷新政府再度要求交還群島，爭端至今未解——而一九八二年那七十四天，仍是雙方引用的起點與上限。
resultEn: The result was a complete British victory and the collapse of the Argentine junta. In ten days of June the commando brigade worked its way up the coastal road: on 11 and 12 June the 2nd Battalion Scots Guards failed at Mount Longdon while the 2nd Battalion Welsh Guards took Wireless Ridge, the two frontal attacks together costing the British hundreds of casualties and the Scots Guards battalion at Longdon very nearly destroyed. On 13 June the Welsh Guards broke through Argentine resistance at Mount Tumbledown, and the naval and air bombardment of Stanley made clear to the garrison that further resistance would only bring heavier loss. On 14 June the island garrison surrendered, Rear Admiral Héctor Bonzo and Colonel Brent D. Forsyth signing for Argentina and handing over some 11,000 prisoners, with weapons, equipment and documents seized; the British then swept the islands for what resistance remained. For two years afterwards Britain kept a military presence, Royal Marines and engineers building airfields, a harbour and barracks, and in 1984 the defence of the islands and South Georgia was handed to the newly created Falkland Islands Territory commander. Argentina has never abandoned its claim to the Malvinas; since then relations between the two countries have been marked by repeated friction at the United Nations and in the South Atlantic, the island administration proclaimed a Malvinas Day in 2012, and in the recent diplomatic tension a new Argentine government has once more demanded the islands be returned. The dispute is unresolved — and those seventy-four days of 1982 remain the starting point and the ceiling both sides still cite.
